about: Windows of recorded bars with the g1 code each has when it is read as a chain. Shared by Vaquum/Composer (the matcher) and Vaquum/Filang (chained_g1): both must read every window here to the same code.
rule: The first bar of a window is read as recorded. Every later bar opens at the close of the recorded bar just before it; its low is the lower of its recorded low and that open, its high the higher of its recorded high and that open; it is up when it closes above that open, down when below, and a doji (z) when equal. The code ranks every endpoint of the window, low, body low, body high and high of each bar, with equal prices sharing a rank, and adds each bar's direction.
units: Each bar is [open, high, low, close] as recorded, in integer cents. `before`, where given, is the recorded bar just before the window and is not part of it.

vectors.name: the second bar opens exactly at the first one's close: both readings agree
the second bar opens one cent above the first one's close: the joint still ties
the previous close is above the second bar's recorded high: the high widens to it
the previous close is below the second bar's recorded low: the low widens to it
the second bar closes at the first one's close: a doji in the chain, a down bar as recorded
the first bar keeps its recorded open, whatever the bar before it closed at
three bars: each later bar opens at the close just before it
